column3: I won't stand for that.
Why hello there, how can I help you?
Necessity is the first cousin of invention.
I just love to tinker.
Welcome, friend!
Pick on someone your own size!
citizens, and friends of Nomeregan! Today is the day we take back our glorious city from that vile trader thermoplug! Gather around me as we prepare to reclaim our homeland!
No more shall our people live as refugees, as outcasts, as wretched, irradiated slaves chained to the yoke of a madman's war machine!
The end of Thermoplug's reign draws near! Gather now at the staging area!
Our tactics, our science, our bravery and determination shall prevail. The assault begins in but a moment.
Operation Nomeregan begins now! Initiate phase one, recapture the enemy airfield, destroy their rocket launchers, and achieve total air superiority!
Targets in sight! Squads deploy! Destroy all enemy rocket launchers!
Haha! That's one down! Keep attacking!
Hahaha! That's another one destroyed! Maintain the assault!
Excellent work! Don't let up!
The airfield is ours! And with it, the sky's over Numeragon! Now our multi-bombers can obliterate Thermoplug's shielded tankbuster cannons! Initiate phase two! Capture the surface command post!
Our multi-bombers have destroyed the tankbuster cannon shields! Hahaha! Take them down and secure the surface command post!

Haha! We've secured the surface! Operation Nomragon is proceeding with 93% efficiency! Well done, everyone! I'll shut down the defensive radiation pumps. Squads, commandeer the remaining mechanized suits and move up to the main entry.

We stand at the brink of victory my friends! Initiate phase three into the tunnels! Once we capture the underground railway and loading dock, we'll use them to make a rapid attack on the heart of the city! Numeragon is within our grasp!
My gears! That's got to be every last trogg in the city! Ah! Squads! Dig in! Frag bombs! And suppressing fire! Hold the line! We won't be turned back now!
Sweet baby titans! That's gotta be the biggest trong I've ever seen! Keep firing! Take it down!
It's too quiet. Where are Therma Plug's Defense Forces?
What is that? That looks like the radiation bomb that poisoned Nomregan! Wait! INCOMING!!!
It's a trap! That's a fully functional irradiator!
Ten minutes? Ha! Plenty of time to disarm the device! Hinkles, hand me that worrying bronze gizmo and some fresh spring water! Cogspin, toss me that dirty trog cloth and a handful of copper bolts!
Haha! We've got to get out of here! Labforge, beam us back! Quickly!

Curses! We had to fall back! But... Therma plug's lost, and he knows it! He's only bought himself time. We hold the surface, and when the radiation clears... We'll assault and recapture Nomregan with a force twice this size!
My old battle suit! Oh, I've missed you!
MECHA TORK BEAM!
MECATORE CANNON!
MECHA TURK MISSILES!
MECHA TORTGRAE!
Deploy the gear! Establish a perimeter!
Oh, hello, friends. We've just about secured the surface. It looks like the real fight's going to be down here.
Don't worry, we've got your back! FORGE AHEAD, BRAVE HEROES!
We've got to take down this portal!

It happened in seconds. We were fighting our way up the shore, and then boom! Explosions of fell energy all around us. And these buildings just grew up out of them, filled with demons. I don't know how we're going to be able to push them back at this rate.
TASTE BLASTER! HAHAHAHA!
FANOBIGAN!
BACK TO THE NEVER WITH YOU!
How are we going to get across?
FEL MAGMA INCOMING! WATCH YOURSELVES!
That magma's going to erupt! Be ready to dock!
Indubitably! I brought some extra machines for backup! Feel free to give them a spin!
My machines are at your command!
I don't have many of them, but the ones I do are at your disposal!
You've got it!
AHHHHHHHHHHHHHH
WAAAAAAAH!
AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH
Time to deploy our simian friend! The horde won't know what hit them.
UNLEASH THE BEAST!
He was a noble fellow who deserved better. Heroes, do what you have to, but please be merciful.
Did someone call for an airstrike?
Stand back, heroes! I'll get you inside the pyramid!
Breach successful! I'll stay out here and keep the skies clear!
Attention horde brutes! This primitive pyramid is now Alliance property!
to demonstrate our capabilities, we've prepared a little, or shall I say, big surprise for you!
You don't have any hope of overcoming no-mish innovation. I advise you to surrender, or to collect a whole lot of bananas.
Alliance Forces! Get to the harbor! I've got you covered!
You plan to stop me with that gaudy piece of junk you call a flight suit? Were you planning to sparkle me to death?
Hah! Slap on all the gold and glitter you want! Your inventions are still cut-rate trash!
Have a taste of superior nomesh artillery!
You asked for it!
Let's see how you handle this little gizmo!
Hello me to introduce a favorite gadget of mine!
Get ready for a shocking twist!
I'd advise you to stay grounded!
Thrusters engaged!
Clear the Lending Area!
Let's cut you down to size!
You've got a small problem on your hands!
I've calculated your odds of survival. They are not in your favor!
You face the pinnacle of Nomesh technology!
Suit failing, not looking good.
Systems compromised! Get me out of here!
Let's put that horrid intellect Galliwick's brags about to the test!
This should keep you busy for a while!
Time to unveil one of my latest inventions!
On behalf of the Alliance, I am prepared to accept your surrender!
The logical thing would be for you to give up now! Hmm... But have I ever known the Horde to be logical?
Your odds of victory are decreasing exponentially by the second!
I know how fond you are of spears and battle axes, but surely you recognize superior technology when you see it?
Target terminated!
One down, more to go!
FOR NOBRAGON!
This is why you invest in gnomish technology, not that goblin garbage.
Where... where am I?
What happened? The attack on Dazar'alor.
You have my sincerest gratitude, Prince Erasman, as do you, Kelsey, and you, Champion.
Well then, let's recycle some scrap!
We'll make quick work of this lot!
I can hardly believe my eyes, the fabled city of Mechagon, most impressive Prince Erasman.
Prince Erasman, it is I who am honored. I will accept your request with one condition.
You must promise to stand beside me as my counselor and my friend.
Come, let us address our people, together!
Remember, safety first!
Never reject an idea out of hand!
There's always time to tinker.
When in doubt, plan it out!
Perseverance is the true blueprint to success!
For Nomeregan!
I'm counting on you!
Well, fancy seeing you here!
Is there something on your mind?
Got something to report?
There's a joke I could tell, but I'm still workshopping it.
Watch it! Keep poking me and I'll show you no mercy! That's NOOOOMM MURCY! Get it?
You make me regret ever leaving my escape pod!
Razzle-crush-cog is no more! The people of Ironforge and Nomeregan speak with one voice this day! Hear us well, thermoplog! The day of your defeat approaches!
Mechjaneer Thermaplug refuses to acknowledge that his defeat is imminent. He has sent Razzlo Crushcog to prevent us from rebuilding our beloved Gnomeregan!
But our brave friend here has thwarted his plans at every turn. And now the dwarves of Ironforge stand with us!
Let's send him crawling back to his master, in defeat!
WE'VE DONE IT! WE ARE VICTORIOUS! HAHA!
With Crushcog defeated, Thermoplug is sure to be quaking in his mechano tank! And rightly so! You're next, Thermoplug! You're next!
We assembled a mighty force and defeated Therma Plug's servants, fighting our way into the city. But the usurper Therma Plug had one last trick up his sleeve.
Oh, we were forced to retreat. Therma plug continues to hide behind the radiation, sending his crony crush cog to harass us here on the surface.
